neal: Heads-up: noticed fat-tail latency on Console dashboards during tenant-heavy queries. Root cause looks like RBAC checks happening per-row during fanout. Repro in staging. /cc @alison @tara

alison: :eyes: Can you paste the flame or a quick query?

neal: Quick numbers from staging run — median ~120ms but p99/p999 spike a lot. Looks correlated with authz RPCs executed after fanout.

perf-bot: snapshot: /dash/query — p50=120ms p95=320ms p99=950ms p999=1800ms — 0.2% elevated errors during test window.

tara: If RBAC is evaluated post-fanout we pay per-row. Two options: prefilter earlier (reduce fanout) or batch authz decisions. Prefilter helps latency but needs a small projection service.

samir: Security note: prefilter must not leak tenant metadata. Any hint pushed upstream must be an allow/deny token signed by authz service. TTLs + invalidation are tricky.

alison: Agreed. We should quantify break-even. Prefilter reduces CPU & downstream DB load but adds complexity (store, invalidation). Batch authz is simpler but still O(N) on cache misses.

neal: Proposed incremental plan:
- add authz cache at query gateway that returns signed allow tokens per tenant-route (ttl 30s)
- implement "narrow-first" execution to run cheap filters before heavy joins
- canary the prefilter on 5% traffic with automatic fallback to legacy checks

tara: Can we run a synthetic that scales fanout to 1k tenants to model tail and cost? Also need ops playbook if cache staleness causes false positives.

samir: I'll draft a token format. Requirements: issued_at, ttl, tenant_id, route, nonce, HMAC(KMS). Verification lib will be tiny and constant-time.

alison: For rollout add a feature flag + config snippet. Example:

```
authz_execution_mode: "prefilter"  # prefilter|batch|legacy
prefilter_ttl_seconds: 30
```

alison: Also add metric hooks: token_hit_rate, token_verify_latency, post-filter fallback rate.

neal: OK I'll open an RFC with perf baselines, synthetic plan, token spec, canary checklist, and rollback steps. Short checklist for PRs: perf test, unit tests for token lib, ops runbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
